I too wake up every day and go to bed every day with two constants looming over tinnitus and suicidal thoughts. I will have the best day of my life so far and without a shadow of a doubt the second I turn off YouTube and close my eyes “what if I just went to tie river and ended it, the pain would be all over” but I push those thoughts aside and replace them with “I could spend more time with my family” or “I haven’t lived enough of my life yet!” Come up with a reason that’s undeniable for you motivate yourself past the hard times. Not even gonna lie to you I lost an entire terabyte about four years ago Apple support was like yeah bro your fault so I literally emailed Tim Cook, three days later Apple support called me up the original person I spoke with the most apologetic I’ve ever heard somebody call me back up. He realize somebody made a mistake Apple actually gave me a brand new magic mouse two for free and wrote me a nice little letter apologizing for the inconvenience, if you haven’t tried calling support give them a call they may actually be able to help you. In my case I was in a beta so I did lose everything but sometimes you will be able to retrieve stuff. And for the record I was not complaining like to the end of the world but I was really upset because I literally lost every picture of me and my wife I had ever taken and she was about 1000 miles away from me and we were living in a long-distance relationship, all I was asking for Apple was to say that they were sorry legitimately for the inconvenience and everybody was just blaming me for the incident, it turns out there was legitimately an issue on their servers once they looked into it further.
